# Donations Drop-off in New York with Getcho


Whether you’re clearing out your closets or simply looking to make a meaningful donation, the convenience of prompt and reliable drop-off can make all the difference to those who need it. Introducing Getcho, your trusted partner for same-day pickup and New York City donations drop-off.


Our efficient platform ensures that your contributions of books, clothes, toys, household items, sporting goods, musical instruments, and more reach those in need swiftly and seamlessly. Experience the ease of scheduling pickups on-demand through Getcho’s dedicated network of couriers and support agents. Make every donation count with Getcho’s reliable NYC drop-off delivery & pick up service.


## Featured Donation Centers in NYC for Donation Drop-offs Using Getcho


### Manhattan, New York


Manhattan boasts plenty of locations where you can drop off donations using a Getcho courier. From local charities to thrift stores, shelters, and community centers, Getcho makes it easy to ensure your donations of books, clothes, toys, household items, and more reach their destinations quickly.


[The Salvation Army](https://www.salvationarmyusa.org/usn/) has two Manhattan locations: 175 East 125th Street and 540 Lenox Avenue. They take clothes, hats, gloves, books, and household items. To find more locations, you can search on their[site here](https://satruck.org/) .


[Grand Central Neighborhood Social Services Corp](http://www.grandcentralneighborhood.org/donations/) . on 120 East 32nd Street accepts clothes, shoes, toiletries, and non-perishable items. Note: Please do not donate used undergarments, opened toiletries, used cosmetic supplies, medication/over-the-counter drugs (except bandages), used bedding or sheets, knives/razors, and toys are not accepted.


[Xavier Mission](https://xaviermission.org/program/clothing-room/) on 55 West 15th Street takes not only your clothing, but also toiletries, sleeping bags, and even diapers and formula.


[The Cathedral Church of Saint John the Divine](https://www.stjohndivine.org/education-outreach/cathedral-community-cares) located at 1047 Amsterdam Avenue at 112th Street accepts clothing.


[Green Drop](https://www.gogreendrop.com/) at 660 North Broadway is interested in a variety of items including clothing, shoes, blankets, bedding, tools, collectibles, kitchenware, toys, small appliances, electronics, musical instruments and sporting goods.


[Book Fairies](https://thebookfairies.org/book-fairies-how-to-donate-books/) at 70 North Maine Street is a great place to consider if you’re exclusively looking to donate books.


[Second Chance Toys Acacia Network Housing Skyline Hotel](https://www.secondchancetoys.org/) is for your plastic toys only. Find it at 725 10th Avenue.


### Brooklyn, New York


If you live in Brooklyn, you can drop off more than just clothing and books using Getcho. Electronics, silver, purses, and sheets are just a few items that Getcho’s reliable network of couriers is ready to pick up and deliver at the following stores.


[Big Reuse](https://bigreuse.org/pages/donate-materials) located at 112th Street accepts hardware, books, clothing, electronics, and home goods—but call the store to verify drop-off hours.


[St. Mary’s Clothing Drive](https://www.stmarysclothingdrive.com/) at 230 Classon Avenue takes clothes, hats, gloves, shoes, linens, towels, purses, sheets, silverware, cookware, dinnerware, and small toys.


[Second Chance Toys - Acacia Brooklyn Family Sanctuary](https://www.secondchancetoys.org/) on 20 Osborn Street collects only on Earth Week and again around the winter holidays.


### Queens, New York


If you’re looking to drop off toys in Queens, Getcho makes it simpler than ever to give back to kids in need.


[Second Chance Toys - Acacia Network Gate Hotel](https://www.secondchancetoys.org/) on 132-26 South Conduit Avenue collects only on Earth Week and again around the winter holidays.


## How to Use Getcho for Donations Drop-off in New York


Whether you are considering NYC donations drop-off in Manhattan, Brooklyn or Queens, Getcho has you covered. You can start by getting pricing and delivery time estimates ASAP using our[quote generation tool](https://getcho.app/) or download the Getcho app.


### Downloading Getcho


Getting started with Getcho is incredibly easy. Simply download the Getcho app from the[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/getcho/id1460402210) or the[Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gtcho)


### **Generating quotes**


You can get quotes for your New York City donations drop-off without creating an account. All you need to do is input the pickup and drop-off addresses, and you will get prices and time estimates instantly!


### **Dispatching your courier**


Input your pick-up details


1. **Pickup for** : Enter the name for whom the delivery is being made. In this case, your name will suffice.
2. **Pickup contact number** : Enter your phone number. This will allow the courier to contact you if there are any issues.
3. **Pickup instructions** : Please provide any additional information necessary to ensure a successful pickup. For example: “Ring the doorbell and I will come down.”


### Input your drop-off details


Please provide any relevant notes to assist the driver in locating the drop-off location (in this case, the donation center you selected). This may include special instructions, or any other details that can facilitate a smooth donation drop. Most donation centers will have a drop-off location inside or outside their building.


Done! Getcho will send you a tracking link to view the status of your courier. Feel free to contact your driver and check in anytime!
